title: Pause Menu Pranking
description: Allows you to randomize the Give Feedback and Report Bugs buttons to prank your friends when sharing your screen.
body:
Prank your friends on discord calls by replacing the Send Feedback and Report Bugs buttons! They likely won't notice but you'll snicker everytime you pause!

WARNING! this mod is very hacky due to my skills and as such can be a bit confusing to use! it's also something pretty much only I care about but I feel like posting it for others to enjoy!!!!!!!!

Small jank tidbit I wish to mention: when the unmodified buttons are present, the mod menu button will be there in some capacity no matter what you do. this is an issue because it will NOT be there no matter what you do when modified buttons are present!! I work around this by making the mod menu button (when "Game Menu: Icon" is set) transparent with a resource pack. unpack the mod menu jar to find this icon.

Requires [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api). Also requires [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) for configuration.
